name: Ayna: Shattered Truth
description:
About This Game

Play as Sae on her journey to find her place in the world. A next generation Metroidvania that combines challenging combat, thrilling platforming, intricate puzzles, and emotional storytelling to provide a whole new way to experience this story.

GAME FEATURES

  • A next generation Metroidvania that combines combat, platforming, and puzzles with a strong narrative focus

  • Bringing traditional 2D side scroller controls, looks and feels to 3D with tightly tuned 2D controls

  • Slash your way through even the most deadly enemies

  • Use different melee attacks with unique attack combos to get the upper hand

  • Special range attacks aid you in battle

  • Explore different regions with vastly different environment designs

  • Player paths bring 3D exploration to 2D side scroller mechanics without losing the traditional charm

  • Upgrade your weapons, skills, and player stats

  • Interact with various NPCs that react to your decisions and behaviour

PC GRAPHICS

  • Support for NVIDIA DLSS, AMD FSR, and Unity STP upscale technologies

  • Support for both 21:9 ultra-widescreen and 32:9 super ultra-widescreen displays to enjoy the breathtaking fairytale world of Ayna: Shattered Truth with a panoramic immersive widescreen feeling

AUDIO

  • Support for 3D Audio (Spatial Sound) through Windows Sonic, Dolby Atmos, or DTS:X

CONTROLS

  • Keyboard and mouse support

  • Controller support for both Xbox Controllers and PlayStation Controllers

  • Customization support to rebind input buttons to personal preferences for keyboard, mouse, and controller

  • UI with complete button prompt support for all supported input configurations
short_desc: Explore this immersive 2.8D Metroidvania fantasy world to uncover its mysteries along with forgotten secrets. Slay monsters with visceral combat skills to survive. Unlock striking abilities and upgrade existing ones to overcome challenges. Befriend odd characters or demolish existing friendships.
